row.locator: - Scroll track (0xa032–0xa10e, 0xbcc6): byte21 (0xadfe: width > height) selects base -8288, else -8280; tier is 0 when byte47, else 1 when byte20, else 3 when pressed, else 2; the track cicn is base + tier fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt 'Copl' low word, 0x9f3e–0x9f58); when the thickness (0xbc92) is at most 11 the id + 18 is probed first; when Acid byte +33 (byte18) or byte77 is set the id + 4 is probed first; a NULL result is not retried at another tier.
row.claim: Track cicn = (-8288 horizontal | -8280 vertical) + tier (0 inactive, 1 disabled, 2 normal, 3 pressed); small (+18) and +4 variants probed first when their gates are set; no cross-tier retry.
row.limits: Fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl); which open file supplies a found id is not established. The +4 gate bytes come from the undecoded Gestalt(Acid) block.

row.locator: - Scroll arrows (0x9f0e–0x9f38, 0xc338–0xc84a): an inactive control (byte47) draws no arrow (0xc34a); with byte72 the arrow boxes come from the track cicn, and for a pressed control each arrow that is not the hit one uses cicn a2@(66) - 1 (0xc3cc–0xc3fe); without byte72 the icon id is the blob word at +24 + 8*high + 4*vertical + 2*hit (0xc79e–0xc7b6), hit meaning hilite 20 for the low arrow and 21 for the high one, and a disabled control (byte20) instead uses -10206/-10205 horizontal or -10208/-10207 vertical (0xc7ba–0xc7fa); icons are drawn through 0xf4ba, which requires the ics# mask (0xf50c–0xf51e).
row.claim: Inactive: no arrows. Composite track: arrow boxes from the track cicn, non-hit boxes of a pressed control from id - 1. Otherwise icon ids from the record table (hit = hilite 20 low / 21 high), disabled ids -10206/-10205 (h) or -10208/-10207 (v); 0xf4ba requires the ics# mask.
row.limits: Selection only. Icon depth, the resource file in force at 0xf4ba and box geometry are not decoded.

row.locator: - Scroll thumb (0xaed6–0xaf84): nothing is drawn if 0xbbf4 yields an empty thumb rect; a disabled control (byte20) redraws the track in the thumb rect (0xaf08–0xaf20) and draws no thumb; hilite 129 selects -10205 horizontal or -10207 vertical, otherwise -10206 or -10208; at thickness 11 or less the id + 1956 is probed first; both go through 0x10472.
row.claim: Disabled (byte20): no thumb. Otherwise -10205/-10207 for hilite 129, else -10206/-10208 (horizontal/vertical), small +1956 first, through 0x10472.
row.limits: Drawn only when 0xbbf4 yields a non-empty thumb rect; that geometry is not decoded and is assumed non-empty at the sampled length.

row.locator: - Scroll draw order (0xa44c–0xa4e2): arrow 0 (low) unless byte18 or byte77, arrow 2 when either is set, arrow 3 (high) always, arrow 1 when byte18, then the thumb.
row.claim: The draw message draws arrow 0 and arrow 3 (and arrows 2/1 under the Acid double-arrow bytes), then the thumb.
Lay out the arrow boxes, track fill between them and the thumb rect (0xbbf4) as the 2.3.1 scroll-bar CDEF does.

evidence.locator: - Scroll state bytes (0x9f7a–0x9fd6, 0xada2, 0xa01c–0xa030): blob byte47 (inactive) is set for hilite 254, and for hilite 255 when Gestalt('appr') succeeds and GetSuperControl's parent is not active; byte20 (disabled) is set for hilite >= 254 or min == max (0xada2; read through the local helpers 0x996c/0x995a when Gestalt('apvr') is at least 0x110, else directly); a hilite of 1..253 is pressed.
evidence.claim: Hilite 254 (or 255 under an inactive Appearance parent) sets byte47 inactive; hilite >= 254 or min == max sets byte20 disabled; hilite 1..253 is pressed.
evidence.limits: Byte derivation only. Which caller action produces each hilite, and GetSuperControl/IsControlActive results, are not established.

evidence.locator: - Scroll track (0xa032–0xa10e, 0xbcc6): byte21 (0xadfe: width > height) selects base -8288, else -8280; tier is 0 when byte47, else 1 when byte20, else 3 when pressed, else 2; the track cicn is base + tier fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt 'Copl' low word, 0x9f3e–0x9f58); when the thickness (0xbc92) is at most 11 the id + 18 is probed first; when Acid byte +33 (byte18) is set and the along length is at least 8 × thickness the id + 4 is probed first; a NULL result is not retried at another tier.
evidence.claim: Track cicn = (-8288 horizontal | -8280 vertical) + tier (0 inactive, 1 disabled, 2 normal, 3 pressed); small (+18) and +4 variants probed first when their gates are set; no cross-tier retry.
evidence.limits: Fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl); which open file supplies a found id is not established. The +4 gate bytes come from the undecoded Gestalt(Acid) block.

evidence.locator: - Scroll composite flag (0xa14e–0xa184): byte72 is set when the selected track cicn's bounds exceed 16 in width or height.
evidence.claim: byte72 = the selected track cicn bounds exceed 16 in width or height; it selects arrow boxes cut from the track (set) or arrow icons (clear).
evidence.limits: Flag only; the arrow box extents and track fill are not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll track pattern (0xa112–0xa14a): a ppat with the record id a2@(66) is fetched (on a miss: id - 4 when the +4 track variant was taken, then base + tier); 0xba0e and 0xc6e4 draw with it when present, by a path not decoded here.
evidence.claim: A ppat with the track record id is fetched and used by the track and arrow draws when present.
evidence.limits: The ppat draw path is not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll arrows (0x9f0e–0x9f38, 0xc338–0xc84a): an inactive control (byte47) draws no arrow (0xc34a); with byte72 the arrow boxes come from the track cicn, and for a pressed control each arrow that is not the hit one uses cicn a2@(66) - 1 (0xc3cc–0xc3fe); without byte72 the icon id is the blob word at +24 + 8*high + 4*vertical + 2*hit (0xc79e–0xc7b6), hit meaning hilite 20 for the low arrow and 21 for the high one, and a disabled control (byte20) instead uses -10206/-10205 horizontal or -10208/-10207 vertical (0xc7ba–0xc7fa); icons are drawn through 0xf4ba, which requires the ics# (0xf50c–0xf51e) and draws the ics8 from the ics#'s own file, or the 1-bit ics# image when there is none; ics4 is never requested.
evidence.claim: Inactive: no arrows. Composite track: arrow boxes from the track cicn, non-hit boxes of a pressed control from id - 1. Otherwise icon ids from the record table (hit = hilite 20 low / 21 high), disabled ids -10206/-10205 (h) or -10208/-10207 (v); 0xf4ba requires the ics# mask.
evidence.limits: Selection only. Icon depth, the resource file in force at 0xf4ba and box geometry are not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll thumb (0xaed6–0xaf84): nothing is drawn if 0xbbf4 yields an empty track rect; a disabled control (byte20) fills the whole track rect (0xaf08–0xaf20) and draws no thumb; hilite 129 selects -10205 horizontal or -10207 vertical, otherwise -10206 or -10208; at thickness 11 or less the id + 1956 is probed first; both go through 0x10472.
evidence.claim: Disabled (byte20): no thumb. Otherwise -10205/-10207 for hilite 129, else -10206/-10208 (horizontal/vertical), small +1956 first, through 0x10472.
evidence.limits: Drawn only when the track rect (0xbbf4) and the thumb rect (length 0xab68, position 0xa97c) are non-empty; that geometry is decoded in docs/spec/engine/scrollbar.md (non-empty at the sampled length 120) but this row asserts selection only.

evidence.locator: - Scroll draw order (0xa44c–0xa4e2): arrow 0 (low) always, arrow 2 when byte18, arrow 3 (high) always, arrow 1 when byte18, then the thumb, then the track.
evidence.claim: The draw message draws arrow 0 and arrow 3 (and arrows 2/1 under the Acid double-arrow byte), then the thumb, then the track.
